Complete your profile and open the offer walls / games sections; read the task or milestone requirements on each offer before starting.
Complete game tasks or reach the required milestones — points are awarded per completed task/milestone, not per hour played.
Redeem via PayPal cash ($5 minimum), Bitcoin, or gift cards (denominations from $5).
Receive the reward — the company claims 99% are delivered digitally within five minutes.
